protocol_reminder: 1) navigate_page to URL. 2) Run ALL-IN-ONE evaluate_script (waits UP TO 15s for REAL content — detects and waits through spinners, 'Loading...' text, and skeletons). 3) hasContent is only true when REAL content loaded (not just a spinner). isStillLoading=true after 15s = STUCK page = major finding. 4) Breadcrumb REQUIRED: .backdrop-blur-sm nav must have text content — missing = minor finding. 5) If PASS: record js_check in page_results. 6) If FAIL: take_snapshot + take_screenshot to FILE, create finding. 7) NEVER call wait_for(). 8) After 20 pages, SAVE and yield.

rules: NEVER mark page passed without navigate_page + evaluate_script JS check in THIS iteration
HTTP HEAD does NOT count as verification - must actually navigate and run JS check
Console errors auto-create findings - cannot be ignored or skipped
Each iteration must test at least 5 pages via full SPTP
Evidence must be fresh from THIS iteration - never copy from prior iterations
On FAILURE: must save snapshot + screenshot to FILE before moving on
After 20 pages in one iteration, SAVE STATE and yield
Re-read protocol_reminder at iteration start to avoid protocol drift

findings.description: Table scroll broken - 28 rows but scrollHeight equals clientHeight (502px). Users cannot scroll to see all purchase orders.
findings.fix_hint: Missing min-h-0 on flex parent of table scroll container. CSS default min-height:auto on flex items prevents bounded scrollable area.
findings.resolution: Virtual scroll active (600 of 2,692 records). VirtualizedFlatTable manages its own internal scroll container (parentRef) which is nested inside TeeemTableView's tableContainerRef. QA test measured scrollHeight on the outer container which doesn't overflow because the inner virtual container handles scrolling. Screenshot confirms table renders correctly with data visible.

findings.description: Table scroll broken - 51 rows but scrollHeight equals clientHeight (1429px). Users cannot scroll to see all financial transactions.
findings.fix_hint: Missing min-h-0 on flex parent of table scroll container. CSS default min-height:auto on flex items prevents bounded scrollable area.
findings.resolution: XeroStatementView (not TeeemTableView) shows 50 server-paginated records that fit within viewport. scrollHeight === clientHeight is correct behavior — user paginates to see more records, doesn't need to scroll. Screenshot confirms page renders correctly with Xero Bank Transactions tab active showing 50 of 1,864 records.
